name: Kisújszállás (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Kisújszállás (a white shield with a red charge and ears of grain, with a helm, a lion crest and red and blue mantling) above the name Kisújszállás in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kisújszállás arms with helm, crest and mantling
